items.title: Wayne Andre interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 7, 2002
items.q: I auditioned for this fellow Ken McKillup

ctx.x: Yeah, it’s interesting. Because my mother took me up to Boston, I was 17 years old, and I auditioned for this fellow Ken McKillup, who was like the assistant to Larry Berk. And they gave me a full scholarship. And I can’t remember the details. I had a full scholarship. I didn’t pay any tuition, based on my audition I guess, and I don’t know if that would have applied to the second, third or fourth year of the school or not but once I got out of the school the first year I ended up going on the road and I never…
It happens frequently with the better players.
